report.summary: The orders service is failing to save orders due to Postgres cluster being in hibernation, causing high 5xx errors
evidence: Postgres pod (orders-db-1) has 18 readiness probe failures with HTTP 500 in last 3 minutes
Postgres cluster annotation cnpg.io/hibernation=on indicates intentional shutdown

suggested_action.detail: Wake up Postgres cluster by removing hibernation annotation or triggering restart via CloudNativePG

rule_verdict.cause: POST /orders is failing: check orders and Postgres
